messages:
maya: Quick ask — I can't find the APAC service overview/dashboard for model + svc health. I tried the grafana shortlink we use for EU and got a 403. Who can share a shortlink or grant view to the infra-viewers group? Need latency + per-model error rates for a customer postmortem.

sam: If you're getting perms it's probably the org split. APAC dashboards are under team 'regional-observability'. Try this shortlink (view-only): https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd1234/service-overview-apac — @lisa or @diego can add infra-viewers.

diego: I can add the group. maya which access do you need — full dashboard or just specific panels?

maya: Full dashboard preferred for the postmortem. Also need the model-health panels (kv cache miss rate, p99 latency) and per-model embedding error trend.

lisa: Adding infra-viewers to that dashboard now. one sec. ops-bot will post when it's queued/applied.

ops-bot: Permission change queued: adding `infra-viewers` to dashboard `d/abcd1234`. Propagation may take ~2m.

maya: Still getting 403 for the shortlink.

oncall-bot: FYI cross-region dashboards sometimes also require `regional-access` in addition to `infra-viewers`. @diego do we need to grant that too?

diego: Good call — adding `regional-access` for maya as well.

ops-bot: Permission change successful: `infra-viewers` + `regional-access` granted to maya on `d/abcd1234`.

maya: I can see it now, thanks! Linking it for the postmortem: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd1234/service-overview-apac?orgId=1

sam: Small follow-up — can someone open a ticket to tune the ModelCPU P95 alert? It's been noisy during large batch jobs. Proposed: bump threshold from 85% -> 90% for V100 pools and split by `model-size` label. Also add a 10m cooldown. cc @eng-sre

maya: Opened INF-4521 with screenshots and notes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4521

diego: Pinging #eng-sre to review the alert change. Also suggest evaluating the alert on historical data before merging.

lisa: I'll update the alert config PR checklist to require a short evaluation note + cooldown setting.

sam: For folks who want quick panel links: panel ids on that dash are: 5 (p99 latency), 8 (error-rate by model), 12 (kv-cache hit). You can share panel-only links from Grafana > Share > Direct link.

sam: Quick API tip if you want to list panels:

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRAFANA_TOKEN" "https://grafana.redwood.com/api/dashboards/uid/abcd1234" | jq '.dashboard.panels[] | {id, title}'
```

maya: Saved the panel ids and added them to the postmortem. :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks all — let us know if eng-sre wants different thresholds per model-size.

maya: Will do. Appreciate the quick help!
